ev.st_low_bread.title: Bread on credit
ev.st_low_bread.text: The shopkeeper looks at you over the counter: «No more credit. Your sort can't be trusted.»
ev.st_low_bread.beg.ok: He relented - and the whole street heard you beg.
ev.st_low_bread.work.ok: Two shifts in a row, hands shaking. But there is bread on the table.
ev.st_low_bread.hunger.ok: A few days on water and crusts. You held out, but it cost you.
ev.st_low_corvee.title: Forced labour
ev.st_low_corvee.text: People like you are rounded up for public works: digging, hauling, mending the road. No pay.
ev.st_low_corvee.obey.ok: A month of hard labour. Your back still remembers it.
ev.st_low_corvee.bribe: Slip the overseer a few coins
ev.st_low_corvee.bribe.ok: The overseer looked away. Some other poor soul went instead.
ev.st_low_corvee.hide.success: They never found you. The work went on without you.
ev.st_low_corvee.hide.failure: They found you, punished you in public and sent you to work anyway.
ev.st_low_mockery.title: Mocked by the mighty
ev.st_low_mockery.text: A rich neighbour laughed at your clothes and your family in front of everyone. People wait to see what you'll do.
ev.st_low_mockery.endure.ok: You kept quiet. The insult stayed inside.
ev.st_low_mockery.answer.success: Your reply was so sharp that now they laughed at him. People remembered you.
ev.st_low_mockery.answer.failure: The rich man's servants didn't like the joke. You left with bruises.
ev.st_low_mockery.complain.success: The elders made him apologise. Unheard of!
ev.st_low_mockery.complain.failure: The elders just waved you off: «Know your place.»
ev.st_low_solidarity.title: Your own won't abandon you
ev.st_low_solidarity.text: In a hard month the poor neighbours gathered by the fire one evening and agreed to help each other.
ev.st_low_solidarity.accept.ok: A sack of flour and a few coins - not much, but just in time.
ev.st_low_solidarity.share.ok: You gave your last to those who had nothing. People respect you for it.
ev.st_low_chance.title: A chance to get ahead
ev.st_low_chance.text: A craftsman on the next street is looking for a helper - hard work, but you could learn a trade.
ev.st_low_chance.take.ok: He is strict, but he really teaches. Now you have a trade in your hands.
ev.st_low_chance.stay.ok: You chose not to risk it. The old way is calmer.
ev.st_mid_elder.title: Headman
ev.st_mid_elder.text: The neighbours ask you to become headman of the quarter: settle disputes, collect dues, speak to the authorities.
ev.st_mid_elder.accept.ok: Plenty of trouble and plenty of money spent on hospitality - but people listen to you.
ev.st_mid_elder.decline.ok: Let someone else bother. You have enough on your plate.
ev.st_mid_envy.title: A neighbour's envy
ev.st_mid_envy.text: A neighbour whispers up and down the street that your wealth was gained dishonestly. People start to look askance.
ev.st_mid_envy.ignore.ok: The rumours didn't die down. Some believed them.
ev.st_mid_envy.gift: Win him over with a gift
ev.st_mid_envy.gift.ok: The gift did its work: suddenly he remembered what a fine person you are.
ev.st_mid_envy.confront.success: Calmly, before witnesses, you took his stories apart. He was ashamed.
ev.st_mid_envy.confront.failure: The talk became a quarrel. Now there are twice as many rumours.
ev.st_mid_friend_loan.title: A friend asks for a loan
ev.st_mid_friend_loan.text: {npc}, your old friend, asks to borrow money: «I'll pay you back in a year, I swear.»
ev.st_mid_friend_loan.refuse.ok: You said no. {npc} left, slamming the door.
ev.st_mid_friend_loan.lend.success: {npc} paid you back with interest and with thanks.
ev.st_mid_friend_loan.lend.failure: A year passed, then another. No money - and {npc} started avoiding you.
ev.st_mid_levy.title: A new levy
ev.st_mid_levy.text: The authorities announced a new levy - and it falls on people of middling means.
ev.st_mid_levy.petition.success: The petition was granted: the levy for the quarter was cut. People thank you.
ev.st_mid_levy.petition.failure: The petition was refused, you were marked as stubborn and charged more.
ev.st_mid_levy.hide.failure: The deception came out. A fine and disgrace.
ev.st_mid_match.title: A match above your station
ev.st_mid_match.text: {npc} has come of age, and matchmakers from a richer family are at the gate. An honour - and a big expense for dowry and feast.
ev.st_mid_match.accept.ok: The wedding was grand and the connections useful. {npc} is not so happy.
ev.st_mid_match.decline.ok: You turned the grand matchmakers away. {npc} is grateful: the heart wants what it wants.
ev.st_up_petitioners.title: Petitioners
ev.st_up_petitioners.text: There's a queue at your door again: poor relatives, neighbours, widows. Everyone knows what you have.
ev.st_up_petitioners.give.ok: You gave away a lot. Your generosity is talked about all around.
ev.st_up_petitioners.refuse.ok: The door is shut. The money is safe, your good name is not.
ev.st_up_office.title: A seat of power
ev.st_up_office.text: An office is for sale: expensive, but it brings weight, connections and income.
ev.st_up_office.buy.ok: Now you have a seal and a seat at the table of the powerful.
ev.st_up_office.decline.ok: You decided a quiet life is worth more.
ev.st_up_rival.title: A rival
ev.st_up_rival.text: Another rich man undercuts your deals and lures your people away. You can't put up with him any longer.
ev.st_up_rival.deal.ok: You split the market. He became almost a friend.
ev.st_up_rival.ignore.ok: You backed down. Your rival tells everyone of his victory.
ev.st_up_rival.fight.success: You outwitted him. Business is booming.
ev.st_up_rival.fight.failure: He was cleverer. You lost money and face.
ev.st_up_robbers.title: The robbers know who's rich
ev.st_up_robbers.text: A gang roams the area. They say it is eyeing the rich houses - yours too.
ev.st_up_robbers.guard.ok: Watchmen at the gate aren't cheap, but you sleep soundly.
ev.st_up_robbers.trust.failure: The house was robbed at night. You were struck when you ran out at the noise.
ev.st_up_tutor.title: A tutor for the children
ev.st_up_tutor.text: {npc} is growing up, and friends advise hiring a tutor: letters, sums, good manners.
ev.st_up_tutor.hire.ok: The tutor is strict, but {npc} is trying hard. You are pleased.
ev.st_el_intrigue.title: Court intrigue
ev.st_el_intrigue.text: At court a plot is being woven against one of the first men of the realm. You are given a hint: join us.
ev.st_el_intrigue.stay_out.ok: You stayed aside. They think you a coward - but a living one.
ev.st_el_intrigue.join.success: The plot succeeded. You got your share of power.
ev.st_el_intrigue.join.failure: The plot was uncovered. Yours was one of the first names given.
ev.st_el_intrigue.warn.success: The man you saved did not forget: now he is your patron.
ev.st_el_intrigue.warn.failure: The plotters found out who betrayed them. You have a deadly enemy.
ev.st_el_duel.title: A challenge
ev.st_el_duel.text: A noble rival challenged you before witnesses. To refuse is a disgrace for your whole line.
ev.st_el_duel.refuse.ok: You refused. Now they whisper behind your back.
ev.st_el_duel.champion: Send a champion in your place
ev.st_el_duel.champion.ok: The hired fighter won. Honour saved, if bought.
ev.st_el_duel.accept.success: You won. The duel will be talked about for a long time.
ev.st_el_duel.accept.failure: You lost and barely survived. The wounds took long to heal.
ev.st_el_endowment.title: A gift to the temple
ev.st_el_endowment.text: The great houses compete in generosity: who builds more, who feeds more of the poor.
ev.st_el_endowment.endow.ok: Your name was carved over the entrance. People pray for your family.
ev.st_el_endowment.small.ok: A modest gift. Noticed, but not remembered.
ev.st_el_endowment.none.ok: Your name was not spoken in the temple. Everyone noticed.
ev.st_el_disfavor.title: Disfavour
ev.st_el_disfavor.text: The ruler is displeased with your house. At court people already look away.
ev.st_el_disfavor.gifts.ok: The gifts softened his anger. The treasury is empty.
ev.st_el_disfavor.leave.ok: You left for another land. Quieter, poorer, but calmer.
ev.st_el_disfavor.plead.success: The ruler relented and even smiled.
ev.st_el_disfavor.plead.failure: The ruler's anger only grew. Part of your estates was taken.
ev.st_el_alliance.title: A marriage alliance
ev.st_el_alliance.text: {npc}, your child, could marry into a great house. Power and wealth - but {g=npc_sex:his|her} heart is not in it.
ev.st_el_alliance.accept.ok: The alliance is sealed. The family is stronger, {npc} is sadder.
ev.st_el_alliance.refuse.ok: You turned down the great house. They won't forget - and neither will {npc} forget your kindness.
ev.st_rise.title: A chance to rise
ev.st_rise.text: A rare chance has come your way: put everything into a big venture that could lift your family a step higher.
ev.st_rise.decline.ok: A bird in the hand. You kept what you had.
ev.st_rise.risk.success: It paid off! You rose higher than your parents ever dreamed.
ev.st_rise.risk.failure: The venture failed. Everything you put in is lost, for a long time.
ev.st_fall.title: A great fall
ev.st_fall.text: Disaster has struck your house: a false accusation, a partner's debts, the anger of the powerful. Everything you built is at stake.
ev.st_fall.settle.ok: You gave up a third of your fortune to be left alone.
ev.st_fall.flee: Flee with what you can carry
ev.st_fall.flee.ok: You fled to another land, leaving almost everything behind.
ev.st_fall.fight.success: You proved you were right. Your enemies are put to shame.
ev.st_fall.fight.failure: The fight is lost. Your fortune went on courts and fines.
